landing.metaTitle: Agora — Meet your people in real life
landing.metaDesc: Tell Agora the kind of night you want. We find the room — nearby events that match your taste in music, sport, film, and conversation.
landing.heroSub: We work too much. We scroll too much. We meet too little. Agora finds you small, real-world gatherings tonight — picked from your taste in music, sport, film, and the things you actually care about.
landing.pillar1Desc: “Quiet bar with people who like Phoebe Bridgers.” “Sunday long run, 10k pace.” Type it. We'll match it.
landing.pillar2Desc: Coffee roasters, climbing gyms, film clubs, run crews. Local hosts, not algorithms.
landing.pillar3Desc: No swipes. No DMs. RSVP and walk in. The room does the rest.
landing.hostsTitle: Your room. Filled with the right people.
landing.hostsDesc: Coffees, gyms, trainers, restaurants, clubs — list a gathering and Agora puts it in front of locals who already want exactly what you're offering. See what your neighborhood is asking for tonight. Turn one-time attendees into a community you own.
landing.demandLabel: Tonight near you, people are asking for
landing.hostsFooter: Built-in CRM. Lead lists. Demand signals. One app.
landing.closingDesc: Less scrolling. More showing up. Your next favorite night is probably ten minutes away.

bingo.title: Bingo
bingo.lead: Discover the city, complete lines, collect the trail.
bingo.freeAria: Centre square, Agora Free: a gift
bingo.legendNote: Verified needs a partner check (venue QR or code, organiser check-in). Agora has no partner yet, so squares stay self-reported.

how.1d: Nine squares, nine small city challenges. The centre square is free. The month follows Istanbul time.
how.2d: Each challenge opens the compass with a ready question: cafés, exhibitions, stages, neighbourhoods.
how.3d: Tap “I attended” on an event or “I went here” on a place. It's saved as self-reported, on this device. Partner verification isn't available yet.
how.4d: A full row, column or diagonal is a line. Your first three lines map to three reward tiers; no partner has joined yet, so none can be used.

bingo.deviceNote: Saved on this device only. Agora doesn't send your experiences anywhere, and they won't follow you to another phone or browser.
bingo.cardNote: The card renews every month; your badges stay in your profile.
bingo.signedOut: Sign in to keep a Bingo card on this device.

badges.title: Badge collection
badges.lead: Your long-term discovery trail. It stays here even when the monthly Bingo card renews.

coffee.how: Each different café you record counts once; the same café never counts twice. Self-reported visits count.

art.how: Each different exhibition or gallery that fits the “Go to an exhibition” rule counts once.

night.how: Each different concert or live-music event you attend counts once.

nomad.how: Each different district where you record an experience counts once; the same one never counts twice.

culture.how: Each different type of square filled by a verified experience counts once. Self-reported visits don't count, and verification isn't available yet, so this badge can't progress for now.

badges.empty: No trail yet. Start with the matching square on your Bingo card.
